title: The plan tab shows the long-term plan in one read, names an empty plan, and stays accessible
requirement: REQ-309: the long-term plan is visible in the interface, not only in the file. AC-1: a plan tab lists the initiatives with unfinished work, the decisions (freshest first) and the nearest tasks. AC-2: on open, one read of the plan, no polling. AC-3: accessibility - keyboard, headings, and an empty state named in words.
reason: The tester composition has no way to mount the panel and no accessibility engine: no DOM renderer (jsdom, happy-dom, linkedom), no react-dom, no axe-core and no Playwright in the workspace, in the harness cache or globally (only the saxes XML parser matches the search). client.js is a browser bundle mounted through a Cordis slot; its own test pattern evaluates the source with a fake loader whose createElement returns null and exposes no plan model or tab read in __test. A mounted run would have to fake the mount, and the axe result could not be produced at all - so this case is recorded with its steps and expected outcome, not claimed as evidence. It needs a role with a browser (Playwright) and axe-core, or an exported plan model plus a DOM renderer.
steps: Mount the real client.js in a browser with the real state/views/plan.md and count workspace-file reads and command calls while the plan tab opens.
Read the rendered tab: initiatives with unfinished work, decisions newest first, nearest open tasks, and the headings.
Point the panel at an empty plan and at a missing state/views/plan.md: each names the state in words.
Run an axe scan on the open panel and on the plan tab.
Switch tabs with the keyboard (Tab into the tablist, arrow keys/Enter) and check the selected tab and focus follow.
expected: The plan tab shows the initiatives with unfinished work, the decisions freshest first and the nearest open tasks from the real state/views/plan.md; opening it performs exactly one read of state/views/plan.md and zero command calls; an empty plan and a missing file are named in words; an axe scan reports no violations; Tab/arrow keys switch between the panel tabs with visible focus and the panel keeps its headings.
failsWhen: The plan is only in the file (no tab), the tab reads the plan repeatedly or polls, the empty/missing plan shows a blank or a raw error, axe reports a violation, or the keyboard cannot switch tabs.
realism: REQ-309 AC-1..AC-3 and the real state/views/plan.md (12 190 bytes); the red base exists: client.js before commit 7b86a55 has no PLAN_VIEW_PATH, no PlanMode and no plan tab, while the current client.js has all three.
